Privacy, in plain language.

Effective November 5, 2026. This policy describes the Manglo toolkit at manglo.shop.

Your images

Files selected in the image tools are processed in your browser. The tools do not upload those files to a Manglo server. Temporary previews remain in page memory until you clear the workspace, reload or close the page. Files you download are saved by your browser.

Information collected by hosting

Requests to load the website may be recorded by the hosting provider in standard server logs, including IP address, browser details, requested URL and request time. We do not ask you to create an account or enter payment details to use these tools.

Fonts and external services

This website requests fonts from Google Fonts. Those requests send standard connection information, including your IP address, to Google. Your browser may use a fallback font if the request is blocked.

Cookies, analytics and advertising

This version does not include advertising tags, analytics scripts or nonessential cookies. If advertising or analytics is introduced, this policy and any required consent controls must be updated before those services are enabled.

Calculator inputs

Calculator values are handled in page memory. Manglo does not send these values to a server or store them across visits. The copy button uses the browser clipboard only when you click it.

Your choices and questions

You can clear tool results at any time, close the page or block external font requests in your browser. To raise a privacy issue, email faikxbillion@gmail.com. If you email us, your message and address are handled by our email provider, Gmail, and used to respond to your request. Do not include passwords, private images or financial records.
